cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Would you support a small improvement to the front garden? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

mechanism: A confidently presents a completed action as a manageable plan, then adjusts its remaining consequences to obtain the cooperation and retrospective approval A needs.
confusable: Distinguish prospective permission from actual already-done action; distinguish S02 accommodation from simply declaring the other person overruled.
comparison: Garden alteration seeks approval after tree removal; dinner hosting seeks approval after invitations through practical chair concessions.
seedUse: Canonical garden and guests seeds supply completed acts; S02 requires visible adjustments that preserve B willingness, not generic claim of charge.
